name: Bitdeer Technologies Group
summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group operates as a technology company for blockchain and high-performance computing (HPC) in Singapore, the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Finland, Ethiopia, Canada, and internationally. The company offers hash rate sharing solutions, including cloud hash rate and hash-rate subscription plans; and a one-stop mining rig hosting solution comprising deployment, maintenance, and management services for cryptocurrency mining; as well as mining cryptocurrencies for its own account. It also operates mining datacenters to generate hash rates; handles various processes involved in computing, such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, …
